package position

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// CreatePositionInput holds create data.
type CreatePositionInput struct {
	Name string
}

// CreatePosition creates a position or returns an existing one.
type CreatePosition struct {
	Positions repository.PositionRepository
}

// Handle creates or returns an existing position.
func (uc CreatePosition) Handle(ctx context.Context, in CreatePositionInput) (domain.Position, error) {
	existing, err := uc.Positions.GetByName(ctx, in.Name)
	if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return domain.Position{}, err
	}
	if existing != nil {
		return *existing, nil
	}

	if err := uc.Positions.Create(ctx, domain.Position{Name: in.Name}); err != nil {
		return domain.Position{}, err
	}

	created, err := uc.Positions.GetByName(ctx, in.Name)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Position{}, err
	}
	if created == nil {
		return domain.Position{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return *created, nil
}
